# Simulate Area Under the ROC Curve (AUC).

Simulate data with a specified area under the receiver operating
characteristic curve—i.e., the AUC of an ROC curve.

## Usage

``` r
simulateAUC(auc, n)
```

## Arguments

- auc:

  The area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve.

- n:

  The number of observations to simulate.

## Value

Dataframe with two columns:

- `x` is the predictor variable.

- `y` is the dichotomous criterion variable.

## Details

Simulates data with a specified area under the receiver operating
characteristic curve—i.e., the AUC of an ROC curve.

## See also

<https://stats.stackexchange.com/questions/422926/generate-synthetic-data-given-auc/424213>

Other simulation:
[`complement()`](https://devpsylab.github.io/petersenlab/reference/complement.md),
[`simulateIndirectEffect()`](https://devpsylab.github.io/petersenlab/reference/simulateIndirectEffect.md)

## Examples

``` r
simulateAUC(.60, 10000)
```
